author: TeIq
content: Origin: #31. proto-blue-oauth docs detail DPoP-nonce-rotation: AS returns DPoP-Nonce header on each token call; subsequent refresh must carry that nonce in a fresh DPoP proof JWT. atproto.rs documents the path as TODO. Implementation reads sessions.refresh_token_enc, unseals via Crypto, deserializes DPoP keypair, constructs DPoP proof for /token with grant_type=refresh_token, persists the new sealed token + DPoP keypair (same column rotates). Reference: proto-blue-oauth tests/refresh_flow.rs.
